shot7.rival_rationale: A rival explanation of the sigmoidal rutile curve: rate proportional to anatase x Li4Ti5O12 (coupling) instead of a time-only Avrami factor. The two predict different rutile timing at a new temperature if spinel and rutile have different Ea.
